records.notes: This is the capability's ONLY identity, and it is a recognition-only semantic: the goal-driven training route reads it to name stage A (highlighted, no radial menu yet) and nothing taps it directly any more.  Whether a tap can act on the camp is decided by a DIFFERENT quantity -- the gold selection ring's size, read off the same frame by winter_agent_v2/camp_ring.py, which taps the ring's centre when a ring is present and answers None otherwise.  Measured on the pair a human verified by hand (dataset/truth_audit/training_camp_highlight_ambiguity_20260917/): the frame whose tap opened the menu carries a 205x112 ring; the frame whose tap jumped to the world map carries a 7x15 fleck of gold -- a badge edge, not a ring.  Two orders of magnitude, and it is the ring that separates the two states, not the template distance (0.0 against 8.0, the latter sitting exactly on the production gate, which is why the older note concluded the signal could not tell them apart).  Over 46 live stage A frames from five sessions the ring measures x 305-319, y 577-597 (sd 4.3/4.0) while this template's own centre is (346, 682) on every one of them -- 103 px away, 37 px below the ring's lower edge, on bare ground, where a tap is a map tap.  Full evidence: dataset/truth_audit/training_stage_a_20260921/README.md.

schema_note: Optional fields (operator directive 2026-09-22): visual_features (what the control looks like, measured), position_hint (where it sits, always with its basis, never treated as a template), preconditions (what must hold before acting), states (the named states the control or the surface it belongs to can be in), expected_transition (what acting on it should change), verification (how far the record is actually verified -- MEASURED_* is a reading, UNVERIFIED is a hypothesis), related_goals (the goals it serves). Every field is optional and every existing record stays valid without them.  Additional field: ocr_dynamic holds the values a control was seen printing -- a countdown, a cost, a count -- which are read by the state readers and are deliberately NOT part of the control's identity, because a value changes and an identity does not. Additional field: ocr_merged marks a control whose printed name the client draws together with its icon, so that OCR returns one token containing the name instead of equalling it (measured: the 实力详情 button is read as 三实力详情).  It is declared per record and only that record's reading is relaxed; find_printed_words keeps its exact-match default, which exists because a containment match once answered with a different control's position (城镇 inside 我的城镇).
